# Along (actdim-along)

> Provider-agnostic agent-context, memory system, dynamic dashboard, and Knowledge Base engine for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Antigravity).

## Summary
Along provides repositories with an isolated, durable, and human-readable memory directory (`.along/`) and an executive dashboard engine (`/along-dash`). It unifies repository conventions, active issues, architectural decisions, and structured documentation across all AI coding tools.

## Key Capabilities & Components
- **Dynamic Executive Dashboard (`/along-dash`)**:
  - Modular FastAPI + Uvicorn service with interactive OpenAPI Swagger documentation (`/docs`).
  - Reactive Web UI (built on `@actdim/dynstruct` and `@actdim/msgmesh`) with dark theme styling.
  - Interactive Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) visualization of entity dependencies using Cytoscape.
  - Real-time file system change detection and live UI refresh via Server-Sent Events (SSE).
- **Knowledge Base & Fast Search Engine (`/along-kb-search`, `/along-kb-sync`)**:
  - Structured documentation articles in `docs/` (`topic--architecture.md`, `topic--domain-model.md`, `topic--setup-and-workflow.md`, `topic--frontend-frameworks.md`, `topic--dependencies.md`, `INDEX.md`).
  - In-place source provenance tracking and drift detection across `docs/`.
  - Fast structured search across Knowledge Base topics, issues, ADR decisions, and session journals with filtering by entity type.
- **AI Dependencies Discovery (`/along-dep-scan`)**:
  - Automated scanner for Node (`package.json`), Python (`pyproject.toml`, `requirements.txt`), and Rust (`Cargo.toml`).
  - Detects library AI rules (`AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `llms.txt`, package manifest AI keys) and builds an idempotent catalog in `docs/topic--dependencies.md`.
- **Entity Ecosystem & Graph Tracking**:
  - Structured YAML frontmatter (`protocol: along`) for Issues (`.along/ISSUES/`), Milestones (`.along/MILESTONES/`), Risks (`.along/RISKS/`), Spikes (`.along/SPIKES/`), and Sessions (`.along/SESSIONS/`).
  - Unidirectional dependency tracking (`blocked_by`, `related`, `parent`) evaluated dynamically without path breakage.
- **Append-Only Architectural Decision Records (`.along/DECISIONS.md`)**:
  - Single-file ADR log allowing agents to load all active architectural constraints in a single read.
- **Cross-Provider Skills Suite**:
  - 17 provider-agnostic skills installed automatically into Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and Antigravity.
